snippet.title: Anomaly Control Simulator - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: In Anomaly Control Simulator, you become an employee of a secret bureau for anomaly control. Every day, dozens of them pass through your department disguised as ordinary objects while breaking the laws of physics, logic, and reality itself. Watch the creepy Anomaly Control Simulator announcement trailer for this upcoming first-person simulator inspired by Papers, Please and SCP-style containment procedures. Anomaly Control Simulator will be available on PC.
